open_items: S1: confirm whether the follow-up univariate F statistics printed as intervention effects are actually intervention rather than discipline effects. The reconciled screening form questions the labels; the PDF uses intervention-versus-control wording but supplies no correction or original MANOVA output (PDF p. 9, printed p. 1439; PDF p. 10, printed p. 1440). The statistics are retained as printed for audit and must not be interpreted as confirmed intervention effects until the labels are resolved.

Exact distinct-person randomized and analyzed counts, per-arm counts, attendance, consent, duplicate removal, and attrition by reason and study are not reported. Recruitment/enrollment totals precede removal of duplicate participants, nonconsenting students, incomplete submissions, and outliers. Neither degrees of freedom nor rounded table values supply printed person counts (PDF p. 7, printed p. 1437; PDF p. 8, printed p. 1438; PDF p. 9, printed p. 1439).

Identify the unlabeled parenthetical values in Tables 1-2 and obtain participant-level dispersion and uncertainty. The source does not identify them as SDs or SEs or establish whether the table levels are raw or adjusted means (PDF p. 10, printed p. 1440). No dispersion or uncertainty is inferred.

Full-sample S1 arm means and signed differences are not printed. Only per-discipline means and the disputed full-sample test labels are available (PDF p. 9, printed p. 1439; PDF p. 10, printed p. 1440). No means are pooled.

Clarify numeric rubric coding, aggregation of the three raters, and the effective analysis unit. Unit and se_basis follow the described per-respondent submission analysis; no aggregation rule or rater blinding protocol is stated (PDF p. 8, printed p. 1438). The Discussion says evaluators identified AI-assisted ideas by quantity of responses (PDF p. 11, printed p. 1441).

Management originality prints denominator df = 198, while fluency and elaboration print 120. Originality p = .06 in the text and .064 in Table 2. The more precise table p-value is recorded, and the text value and printed df remain in the source quote. No corrected df or inferred count is substituted (PDF p. 10, printed p. 1440).

The Results introduction describes the separate Management MANOVA as having Discipline (Entrepreneurship vs Marketing) as its sole independent variable, although its Results subsection reports an intervention comparison. The reconciled screening also flags the Management Wilks Lambda as inconsistent with its other omnibus statistics. Author analysis output is needed; no replacement statistic is inferred (PDF p. 9, printed p. 1439; PDF p. 10, printed p. 1440).
Randomization mechanics are not stated beyond assignment of individual students within discipline before class (PDF p. 7, printed p. 1437).

Cross-subject duplicates were removed, but their count, affected subject pairs, and record-retention rule are unstated. Initial Marketing-Management overlap is explicitly described; the final overlap of the two analysis samples is not quantified. The screening form identifies no other paper sharing these participants (PDF p. 7, printed p. 1437).
The shared preprocessing section reports two multivariate outliers without allocating them between S1 and S2, and gives no complete count for the earlier outlier removal (PDF p. 9, printed p. 1439).

The study country and the AI release year are not explicitly stated. Country remains not_stated and ai_tool.year remains null; author affiliations do not establish the study location (PDF p. 2, printed p. 1432; PDF p. 7, printed p. 1437).
notes: Reconciled on 2026-10-10 against the saved publisher PDF. Read the complete markdown conversion in contiguous chunks through the final reference; there is no appendix or supplement in the saved document. Extracted the text of every cited PDF page with pymupdf and checked both result tables, including text-based find_tables recovery. All numeric estimate values agreed between A and B and were independently confirmed against the PDF. The supplied diff contains two study-level tool-name differences, six matched estimates, and no estimates present in only one extraction. Resolutions additionally record the three effect-standardizer text-versus-null differences omitted by the numeric diff. Differences in synonymous outcome labels, descriptions, and locator wording were harmonized to the screening form and verified source text. Source fields use stats object keys, with each recorded numeric field assigned to one source. No estimate was added: all six full-sample univariate contrasts are present; the six S1 discipline-subgroup contrasts, both dropped flexibility outcomes, both joint MANOVA tests, discipline main effect, and intervention-by-discipline moderation are inventoried in not_extracted. An omnibus MANOVA test is not a separately scored overall-creativity outcome. The study structure follows the screening form and the two task-specific analyses: S1 combines Entrepreneurship and Marketing, and S2 is Management. Agreed-field audit: study and arm randomized/analyzed counts and estimate person counts remain null because only recruitment/enrollment figures are printed and duplicates and other exclusions are not quantified (PDF pp. 7-9, printed pp. 1437-1439). Classes are not randomized clusters: students were assigned individually within discipline before class (PDF p. 7, printed p. 1437). Every estimate is with_ai, immediate, outcome_with_ai true, and within_person null: the scored output was produced during the assigned task, and the paper reports no paired crossover or first-round comparison. Both arms received the prompting guidance and video, but only the intervention arm was instructed to use ChatGPT during the scored task (PDF pp. 7-8, printed pp. 1437-1438). Fluency is a per-respondent count, coded fluency/category_count with higher_is more_ideas. Originality judges uniqueness of a respondent's ideas, coded novelty/expert_raters; elaboration judges detail, specificity, and richness, coded elaboration/expert_raters. Both use higher_is more_creative (PDF p. 8, printed p. 1438; interpretation of higher creativity scores on PDF p. 10, printed p. 1440). Originality is not a between-person diversity measure. Participant unit and se_basis follow the per-respondent submission analysis, with the unstated rater aggregation retained as an open item. There is no across_people or after_ai outcome. The control used usual resources, including possible internet searches, so comparisons remain ai_vs_bau; no active aid was assigned. No preregistration or public data/code location is stated. The phrase primary index of creative ideation motivates dropping flexibility, not a preregistered primary-outcome declaration (PDF p. 9, printed p. 1439). The acknowledgement of ChatGPT-4 refers to manuscript editing (PDF p. 13, printed p. 1443). No means, effects, standard deviations, standard errors, or sample sizes were derived. Printed precision is preserved in the verbatim quotes. The supplied mechanical checker reads compact F degrees of freedom such as F(1,198) as a thousands-separated integer. These degrees of freedom were checked directly against the exact cited PDF page and F expression without altering the quotes.
